column1: # Mario Kart World (Switch 2, loose dump of update 917504). Shader split only: no build has been packed or run from this profile, so it claims no
# version hashes and has no android.tsv.
# Nintendo EPD's engine (Nin_Ounce: sead / agl / gsys, Phive), NVN2 (Ampere shaders); modules main + sdk + subsdk0 + subsdk1.
# Shaders: Shader/*.Nin_Ounce_NVN2.bfsha.zs (BNSH), one .sarc.zs holding agl sharcb packs, and the effect set's esetb. See docs/SWITCH2.md.
# ---- Memory (provisional: address-space reservations only, nothing measured on a host yet) ----
# A Switch 2 title plans its heap from a 12 GiB DRAM layout, and NVN2 keeps a second 8 GiB for the graphics server, so the reserve here is sized for
# both. These are host reservations, not values the game reports: mem_reserve 20 GB covers 12 GiB + 8 GiB, mem_alias keeps the 16 GB alias region a
# Switch 1 profile uses, and app_pool is the ~9.5 GiB a 12 GiB title plans (docs/SWITCH2.md). The first native run is what will say whether they are
# right -- nothing has booted this profile yet.
